Aditya / Karthik —

Quick status on the MSA redlines after reviewing ClearWave legal comments:

Open items (summary):
1) Sec 7 — Data retention / deletion: ClearWave requests 12 months retention max for logs and aggregate telemetry. We are proposing configurable retention windows and a mutual deletion workflow. Owner: lauren_bishop — Target: 2027-02-17
2) Sec 12 — Indemnity caps: CW requests no cap for IP claims. We propose a $5M cap for breach-related IP claims, standard for our enterprise contracts. Owner: lauren_bishop / legal — Target: 2027-02-18
3) Export control clause: CW wants explicit warranty. Need Legal input and possible E&O. Owner: karthik_iyer (coordinate with Legal) — Target: 2027-02-22
4) Order form payment terms: procurement asked Net 45, sales prefers Net 30. Owner: aditya_rao — Target: 2027-02-14 (finalize with Procurement)

Vendor onboarding blockers: procurement must provide PO number, W9 (tax), and corporate ACH details. I've attached the vendor setup checklist. Owner: marissa_cole to track with onboarding team.

I'll prepare a tracked redline to send to CW legal once we align internally; aiming to have that to you by EOD 2/17.

—Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Sr. Contracts Manager | Redwood Inference

• MSA — Sec 12 (Indemnity): Owner: lauren_bishop — Status: Open; Redwood proposes $5M cap; ACTION: Lauren to draft rationale memo and exec approval note by 2027-02-18.

• Vendor Setup: Owner: marissa_cole — Status: Blocked by missing PO and W9; ACTION: Marissa to request PO and tax docs; Onboarding can start 24 hours after vendor setup completed.

Meeting notes: we propose a brief 15-minute cadence each Monday morning for the next three weeks to keep this on track — same time slot as our initial call.

Action items (single list):
1) Lauren: finalize internal redline + rationale (due 2/17)
2) Karthik: legal loop on export control (due 2/22)
3) Aditya: confirm payment term position and chase PO (due 2/16)
4) Marissa: collect PO, W9, corporate ACH; open Vendor Setup ticket (due 2/16)

Please reply with any corrections or additional owners; otherwise we'll take these as the MAP for week of 2/14.
